label: Bible Study
prompt: And having food and raiment let us be therewith _____.
verse: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
note: Food and clothing — Paul's whole list of essentials for a contented life.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For this child I _____; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verse: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
note: Hannah, who once wept at Shiloh for a child, brings little Samuel back: for this child I prayed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Moreover his mother made him a little _____, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verse: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
note: Every year Hannah made young Samuel a little coat and brought it when she came up to the yearly sacrifice.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not _____ to me.
verse: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
note: David stopped fasting when his infant son died — he would go to the child, but the child wouldn't come back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's _____.
verse: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
note: Nehemiah's prayer ends with his job title: 'For I was the king's cupbearer' — trusted access he was about to use.
